annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部等十七部门关于印发“机器人+”应用行动实施方案的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Sixteen Other Departments on Issuing the "Robot+" Application Action Implementation Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部 (MIIT) and sixteen other ministries
annotation.summary_en: Cover notice from MIIT and sixteen other Chinese ministries issuing the "Robot+" Application Action Implementation Plan (dated 18 Jan 2023), directing provincial authorities to implement it. The excerpt contains only the transmittal notice, not the plan's substantive text, which promotes robot adoption across sectors.
key_provisions_or_claims: Seventeen ministries jointly issue the 'Robot+' Application Action Implementation Plan.
Provincial industry and information technology authorities and others are told to implement it in light of local conditions.
Document number 工信部联通装〔2022〕187号, dated 18 January 2023, published 19 January 2023.
Plan content itself is not included in the excerpt.
